description: This file contains the implementation of an in-memory grain storage provider for the Orleans framework, including the MemoryGrainStorage class, which handles reading, writing, and deleting grain states in memory, along with serialization/deserialization logic and logging.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorage
classes.description: A simple in-memory implementation of the IGrainStorage interface for development and testing purposes, providing methods to read, write, and clear grain state asynchronously.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the state of a grain asynchronously from in-memory storage, deserializing the stored data into the grain's state.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes the grain's state into in-memory storage asynchronously, updating the ETag.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears the grain's state from in-memory storage asynchronously, resetting the grain state.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes stored binary data into a specified type.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes the grain state into a binary format suitable for storage.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a specified type using dependency injection.

methods.name: MakeKey
methods.description: Constructs a storage key combining grain type and grain ID.

methods.name: GetStorageGrain
methods.description: Determines and retrieves the appropriate in-memory storage grain based on the hash of the key.
